versions.content: function GetAllKeys [SWS_PER_00042] Upstream: RS_PER_00003 , RS_AP_00119 , RS_AP_00120 , RS_AP_00127 , RS_AP_00129 , RS_AP_00135 , RS_AP_00139 , RS_AP_00159 ara::core::Result < ara::core::Vector < ara::core::String > > GetAllKeys () const noexcept; Returns a list of all currently available keys of this Key-Value Storage. The list of keys is only accurate if no key-value pair is added or deleted at the same time. This method uses transaction semantics, it sees the current state of transaction, not the actual physical storage.
